title.rendered: Added: Executive Session of the Board of Directors – February 16, 2022

content.rendered: The agenda for the February 16, 2022 Board of Directors meeting has been revised to include an Executive Session, scheduled for 5:30pm. Please note that Executive Sessions are non-public meetings, and as such, this meeting will not be live streamed or open to audience attendance. The revised agenda can be viewed here. For information about the 7:00pm Regular Meeting of the Board, please click here.
